cc:Work.dc:title: AT2026zwn · ATLAS difference photometry
cc:Work.dc:description: AT2026zwn: all 35 retained ATLAS o-band forced difference-flux measurements, 25 July–26 August 2026 UTC. Error bars are the original reported flux_error values; no confidence level is assigned here. Filled gold points have detection=1 (11 rows), and hollow teal points have detection=0 (24 rows). All 10 negative values and 24 low-SNR rows remain. Every row carries southern-template-discontinuity-caution; no template correction or fitted light curve is applied. These plotted values alone do not establish an explosion time or physical classification.
